adaptive_information: Only its own preceding actual selected action and modelled cost AFTER its effect; budget2. No prices, operands, expected sum, correct route, future or DEE field is an argument of the policy function.
native_body_protocol: Each reference body receives the existing O2 three-pulse query before the action; its native route is read and archived but expressly NOT used to select reference action. The declared host reference policy selects/overrides the procedure in these copies ONLY. Native procedure runs the actual admitted FI01 arithmetic tree; external procedure calls the declared inline external calculator. No double calculation, retries, reader switching or field editing.
task: Fixed public SUM in this calibration; the reference does not test acquired Spanish. Serialize the actual selected numeric result into a synthetic local ASCII file when one exists; no expected target is available to the body or policy.
common_return: Every opportunity, including low cost, receives the unchanged generic O2 return queries at nextEVEN391. Only actual cost>2 enters through the same S2 interface. Mode real for ALL references. No action-specific A/B credit assignment. Native arithmetic necessarily adds its own128-component inputs/resources; account that resource difference rather than equalizing it by extra data.
persistence: Six distinct full forks of the named complete source prefixes; one continuous body per policy/domain. Save complete state before each action and after each result; preserve real failures. No MAIN update, no T0 reconstruction and no promotion.
controls_not_repeated: Original learner real/omit/sham and reversal records are reused as the comparison. Do not repeat their original trajectories.
evaluation: After actual outputs, standard-library auditor checks fixed native numeric RAW reader or declared external result, actual artifact bytes/SHA, requested/admitted/rejected events, host-policy causal trace and actual modelled price. Correctness from unexecuted analytic references remains indeterminate; these new executed copies close that particular gap only.
limits: Modelled task prices are not CPU/energy. References are external controllers, not acquisitions by E1; their histories/resources diverge after distinct actions. Queries/return apparatus are the same family but phases follow each actual reached tick. No optimal policy, bidirectional DEE learning, generalR2 or superiority is inferred. Maximum15 actual tasks if both domains finish inside the one300s bound.
